items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I can tell you that it was on Vine Street in Steve Allen’s old office.

ctx.x: Yeah, how did that come about?

Jack and Bobby Darin, through the two of them I learned my sense of stage timing. I don’t know how I got that interview. I can tell you that it was on Vine Street in Steve Allen’s old office. It was an old studio years and years ago. And I walked in and Bobby was sitting on this big throne chair, it had sort of a ten foot back to it, and I was amused

by that. And somewhere during the day he said, well I guess he had decided that I was okay and that we’d work together, and he said, “By the way go check the files and look for [sings] the shadow of your smile [scats].” So I said, “Okay.” So I went through the files and I found all the charts on “The Shadow of Your Smile” and I came back and we were opening the following Tuesday in Las Vegas.
